description: Design the rolling segment buffer that replaces the MediaRecorder VP8/WebM replay buffer. Decide: segment duration, segment count for default replay windows (e.g. 30s, 60s, 5m), on-disk vs in-memory storage, segment naming, atomic write/rotate strategy, crash safety, total disk footprint cap, container choice (fragmented MP4 vs raw .h264/.hevc + index). Define how segments are stitched on save without re-encoding when possible. Must survive long sessions without unbounded growth, and must allow concurrent capture while a save is in progress (v1.1.0 specifically fixed the freeze-during-save bug — do not regress). Output: design doc with timing, IO budget, and failure modes. No code.
title: Design rolling replay segment buffer
